name_zh: Alpha158 30期价格标准差/当前收盘价
formula_zh: 30期收盘价标准差 / 当前收盘价
intuition_en: Measures price continuation over 30h. Higher values indicate stronger recent upward drift.

expected_direction_explanation_zh: 更高的动量值暗示预期均值回归。
known_limitations_en: Medium rolling price dispersion; sensitive to volatility regime shifts and low-liquidity bars.

horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 30 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
